note: PARTIAL EXTRACTION: 10 of 19 items worded. The live table holds all 19 items of the first draft (the .sav's In_1..In_19, lowercased by data/perceived_injustice_mourin.R, so the code IS the source column name). The .sav carries NO variable labels on In_1..In_19 and no value labels (only Injustice has no/yes), so it cannot tie codes to text. The article publishes only the 10 retained items (S1/S2 File, final items 1-10); it states draft items 4,5,6,7,8,11,12,15,17 were dropped as redundant with key items 10 and 16. The 9 dropped items (in_4,in_5,in_6,in_7,in_8,in_11,in_12,in_15,in_17) ship with blank item_text AND blank option_text (their wording and anchor format were never published; draft form not in the article, its 4 supplements, or the OSF node, whose only file is the .sav); they carry resp rows 0-4 only so every live level has a row. MAPPING reconstructed: final k -> in_1,in_2,in_3,in_9,in_10,in_13,in_14,in_16,in_18,in_19 for k=1..10. The retained SET is verified (unique among all 92,378 10-of-19 subsets in reproducing the paper's alpha .931, corrected item-total range .543-.841, 61.95% variance, and total-score r with Steel .428 / experience .426 / rating .441 / PSS-10 .332 / WHO-5 -.361; draft numbering confirmed by the paper's r>=.8 lists for items 10 and 16), and the frequency-anchored pair (final 9,10) is pinned to {in_18,in_19} by ceiling % (4.5, 16.7 vs 24.9-46.6 for all 17 others). ORDER within the 8 intensity items and between in_18/in_19 is ASSUMED (final form keeps ascending draft order); no per-item statistic is published to check it. Administered in Bangla: base fields are S1 File's Bangla, transcribed from a 300-dpi render of the page because the PDF text layer drops conjuncts/pre-base vowels; the transcription was cross-checked token by token against the text layer after reordering visual vowel signs, all residual mismatches being glyphs the text layer lost (e.g. reph in nirdesh, ya-phala in modhye). Source spellings kept as printed (karone with dental na in item 3, bhishon with dental na in the top anchor). ya-nukta written precomposed (U+09DF) as in the text layer. Instructions: the body of S1's instruction block; the heading 'nirdeshona'/'Instructions.' is omitted. English in _translated is the authors' own S2 File verbatim, including its grammar ('how much these situations applies to you') and its check mark (U+2713, where S1 prints a square-root sign). Rights: the scale's first and only publication is this CC BY 4.0 article by its own authors; no restriction found or quoted. A PsycTESTS record (10.1037/t94677-000) exists and was not fetched (paywalled); per the round lead it does not outrank the authors' CC BY publication.
public_note: Only 10 of this table's 19 items (the retained final scale) carry wording, because the authors never published the other 9 draft items; the match of the 10 wordings to item codes assumes the final scale kept the draft's item order, which the data confirm as a set but cannot check position by position.
